hypotheses.text: If Tomas Vell had carried the ball forward instead, the turnover probability would fall and the chance of creating a scoring opportunity would increase (i.e., dribbling would have been safer than the intercepted pass).

If Tomas Vell had passed to Leo Marchetti (CM) instead, the sequence would have had a lower interception/turnover risk and a higher chance to keep possession in midfield than the attempted pass to H9.
If Bastian Holt (LM, away) had been 5 m closer to Tomas Vell at the moment, increased pressure from that defender would explain the high interception/turnover outcome observed.
